description: A faithful Codex pet recreation of a tiny mechanical bee pup with a brass antenna cap, cream puppy face, yellow-black bee stripes, soft pale wings, and a little flower always in paw.

idle.notes: Quiet standing idle with tiny blink, gentle breathing, and very small antenna and wing motion.

walk.notes: True directional walk rows used for movement and drag-facing behavior.

curious.notes: Soft curious loop with a slight head tilt, forward lean, and flower-focused attention.

happy.notes: Restrained sweet happy loop with a tiny paw lift and brighter expression.

sleep.notes: Cozy dozing loop with closed eyes, lowered body, and the flower still visible.

follow.notes: In-place eager follow loop with tiny anticipatory steps and companion-like readiness.

fly.notes: Gentle hover loop driven by the small wings, with a light buoyant rise and settle.

sit_rest.notes: Gentle seated rest loop with a soft pause and recovery feeling, not a dramatic failure pose.

drag.notes: Directional drag uses the true left-facing and right-facing walk rows.

sniff_flower.notes: No dedicated extra row remained in the fixed atlas, so sniff_flower is approximated by the curious row, which includes a flower-focused lean and sniff-like attention shift.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses a true left-facing strip
right drag uses a true right-facing strip
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
left-facing row keeps head, eyes, nose, body, antennae, wings, bee stripes, and flower aligned left
right-facing row keeps head, eyes, nose, body, antennae, wings, bee stripes, and flower aligned right
antennae, bee stripes, small wings, and flower remain readable at small size
